# planetscale_neki_shard (Data Source)

Manage an individual shard on a PlanetScale Neki branch.
Creating a `planetscale_neki_branch` already provisions its default shard. Do not recreate that shard with this resource; import it if Terraform should manage its display name.
Changing `configuration_profile` reassigns the shard in place and waits for the asynchronous configuration change to complete.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "planetscale_neki_shard" "my_nekishard" {
  branch       = "...my_branch..."
  database     = "...my_database..."
  id           = "...my_id..."
  organization = "...my_organization..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `branch` (String) Branch name from `list_branches`. Example: `main`.
- `database` (String) Database name slug from `list_databases`. Example: `app-db`.
- `id` (String) The ID of the shard
- `organization` (String) Organization name slug from `list_organizations`. Example: `acme`.

### Read-Only

- `authoritative` (Boolean) Whether the shard is the authoritative shard of the cluster
- `configuration_profile` (String) The name of the shard configuration profile
- `display_name` (String) The display name of the shard
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the shard has been created on the cluster
